title: The Dark Knight
overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. But they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known as the Joker.

title: Batman Begins
overview: Driven by tragedy, billionaire Bruce Wayne dedicates his life to uncovering and defeating the corruption that infests his home city of Gotham. Patrolling the streets night after night, Wayne assumes the role of Batman to strike fear into criminals.

title: The Dark Knight Rises
overview: Following the death of District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman assumes responsibility for Dent's crimes. Eight years later, Batman encounters Selina Kyle and the villainous Bane, a terrorist leader who overwhelms Gotham.

title: Inception
overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of targets, is offered a chance to regain his old life for an impossible task: inception, planting an idea into a subconscious mind.

title: Interstellar
overview: A team of explorers travel through a newly discovered wormhole in space to surpass the limitations on human space travel and ensure humanity's survival across interstellar distances.

title: The Matrix
overview: Set in the 22nd century, The Matrix tells the story of a computer hacker who joins underground insurgents fighting artificial intelligence machines that have trapped humanity in a simulated reality.

title: The Matrix Reloaded
overview: Neo and Trinity fight against machines to protect Zion, the last human stronghold, while learning more about the origins and control mechanisms of the Matrix system.

title: Blade Runner 2049
overview: Thirty years after the first film, a new blade runner, LAPD Officer K, unearths a secret that could plunge society into chaos, leading him on a quest to find former blade runner Rick Deckard.

title: Avatar
overview: A paraplegic Marine is dispatched to the alien moon Pandora on a unique mission, but becomes torn between following orders and protecting an alien civilization on a lush extraterrestrial world.

title: The Avengers
overview: When an unexpected enemy emerges and threatens global security, Nick Fury brings together Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, and the Hulk to form the Avengers superhero team.

title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
overview: When Tony Stark attempts to jumpstart an artificial intelligence peacekeeping program called Ultron, the Avengers must assemble to stop Ultron from destroying humanity.

title: Avengers: Infinity War
overview: The Avengers and their superhero allies must be willing to sacrifice everything in an attempt to defeat the powerful cosmic despot Thanos before his blitz of devastation ruins the universe.

title: Iron Man
overview: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil and becomes the superhero Iron Man.

title: Captain America: Civil War
overview: Disagreement over international oversight of the Avengers fractures the superhero team into two opposing factions, one led by Steve Rogers and the other by Tony Stark.

title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
overview: Peter Parker seeks help from Doctor Strange to restore his secret identity as Spider-Man, but a spell goes wrong, breaking open the multiverse and summoning dangerous villains.

title: Toy Story
overview: A cowboy doll named Woody is profoundly threatened and jealous when a new spaceman figure named Buzz Lightyear becomes the top toy in a young boy named Andy's bedroom.

title: Toy Story 2
overview: When Woody is stolen by a toy collector, Buzz Lightyear and his toy friends mount a rescue mission to save him before he becomes a museum property in Japan.

title: Toy Story 3
overview: The toys are mistakenly delivered to a daycare center instead of the attic right before Andy leaves for college, and it is up to Woody to convince the other toys that they were not abandoned.

title: Monsters, Inc.
overview: Top monsters Sulley and Mike work at a factory that generates power from human children screams, but chaos erupts when a sweet little girl accidentally enters the monster world.

title: Finding Nemo
overview: After his young son Nemo is captured in the Great Barrier Reef and taken to Sydney, a timid clownfish named Marlin sets out on an ocean journey with an amnesiac fish named Dory to rescue him.

title: The Lion King
overview: Lion prince Simba and his father are targeted by his bitter uncle Scar, who wants to ascend the throne. Simba flees into exile but returns to reclaim his royal kingdom.

title: Up
overview: An elderly widower named Carl Fredricksen ties thousands of balloons to his house to fly away to Paradise Falls in South America, unknowingly taking a young wilderness explorer with him.

title: Shrek
overview: A mean lord exiles fairytale creatures to the swamp of a grumpy ogre named Shrek, who must go on a quest and rescue a spirited princess for the lord in order to get his land back.

title: The Godfather
overview: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty in New York transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant youngest son Michael Corleone.

title: The Godfather Part II
overview: The early life and career of Vito Corleone in 1920s New York City is portrayed, while his son Michael expands and tightens his grip on the family crime syndicate across Nevada and Cuba.

title: Pulp Fiction
overview: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster and his wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption in Los Angeles.

title: GoodFellas
overview: The story of Henry Hill and his life in the mob, covering his relationship with his wife and his mafia partners Jimmy Conway and Tommy DeVito in the Italian-American crime syndicate.

title: The Departed
overview: An undercover cop and a mole in the police force attempt to identify each other while infiltrating an Irish gang in South Boston.

title: Fight Club
overview: An insomniac office worker and a devil-may-care soap maker form an underground fight club that evolves into much more, spreading into an anarchic anti-consumerist movement.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
overview: Over the course of several years, two convicts form a friendship, seeking consolation and, eventually, redemption through basic compassion inside the walls of Shawshank prison.

title: Titanic
overview: A seventeen-year-old aristocrat falls in love with a kind but poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated R.M.S. Titanic during its maiden voyage across the Atlantic Ocean.

title: The Notebook
overview: A poor yet passionate young man falls in love with a rich young woman, giving her a sense of freedom, but they are soon separated because of their social differences.

title: La La Land
overview: While navigating their careers in Los Angeles, a pianist and an actress fall in love while attempting to reconcile their aspirations for the future.

title: Pride and Prejudice
overview: Sparks fly when spirited Elizabeth Bennet meets single, rich, and proud Mr. Darcy. But Mr. Darcy reluctantly finds himself falling in love with a woman beneath his class.

title: The Conjuring
overview: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren work to help a family terrorized by a dark presence in their farmhouse, facing a terrifying demonic entity.

title: The Conjuring 2
overview: Lorraine and Ed Warren travel to North London to help a single mother raising four children alone in a house plagued by a malicious spirit and supernatural entities.

title: Insidious
overview: A family looks to prevent evil spirits from trapping their comatose child in a realm called The Further after moving into a haunted house.

title: A Quiet Place
overview: A family must navigate their lives in silence while hiding from mysterious extraterrestrial monsters with ultra-sensitive hearing that hunt any sound.

title: The Shining
overview: A family heads to an isolated hotel for the winter where a sinister presence influences the father into violence, while his psychic son sees horrific forebodings from both past and future.

title: The Hangover
overview: Three buddies wake up from a bachelor party in Las Vegas, with no memory of the previous night and the bachelor missing. They make their way around the city in order to find their friend before his wedding.

title: Superbad
overview: Two co-dependent high school seniors are forced to deal with separation anxiety after their plan to stage a booze-soaked party goes awry.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
overview: A meek Hobbit from the Shire and eight companions set out on a journey to destroy the powerful One Ring and save Middle-earth from the Dark Lord Sauron.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
overview: While Frodo and Sam edge closer to Mordor with the help of the shifty Gollum, the divided fellowship makes a stand against Sauron's new ally, Saruman, and his hordes of Isengard.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
overview: Gandalf and Aragorn lead the World of Men against Sauron's army to draw his gaze from Frodo and Sam as they approach Mount Doom with the One Ring.

title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
overview: An orphaned boy enrolls in a school of wizardry, where he learns the truth about himself, his family and the terrible evil that haunts the magical world.

title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
overview: Blacksmith Will Turner teams up with eccentric pirate Captain Jack Sparrow to save his love, the governor's daughter, from Jack's former pirate allies, who are now undead.

title: Arrival
overview: A linguist works with the military to communicate with alien lifeforms after twelve mysterious spacecraft appear around the world.

title: Gravity
overview: Two astronauts work together to survive after an accident leaves them stranded in space with no tether to Earth.

title: Schindler's List
overview: In German-occupied Poland during World War II, industrialist Oskar Schindler gradually becomes concerned for his Jewish workforce after witnessing their persecution by the Nazis.

title: Deadpool
overview: A wisecracking mercenary gets experimented on and becomes immortal but ugly, and sets out to track down the man who ruined his looks.
